key_impacts: Severe social, economic and psychological impacts
evidence_snippets: On 17 January 1995 at 5:46, a Magnitude 7.9 earthquake shook Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan.
It took more than 6,400 lives, destroyed thousands of houses and left millions homeless.
2005 marks the 10th anniversary of the Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake of Kobe (Hyogo).
